items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Yes, Jack Fulton sang that and Skin Young sang the "Chloë" and let's see I think there was another number that we did in the beginning

ctx.x: Yes, Jack Fulton sang that and Skin Young sang the "Chloë" and let's see I think there was another number that we did in the beginning, two numbers. One of them I had made an arrangement of. They used two of them, but they were nondescript numbers. They were nice, but nothing had been
done with them. There had been no records made or anything like that. He used them because he liked them.
